title: pvPlotSelectionOverTime
body:
## pvPlotSelectionOverTime

Extracts the points or cells chosen by a selection (the Selection input, e.g. from pvIDSelectionSource or pvLocationSelectionSource) at every time step and reports their values over time. Output is a multiblock of tables with a time column: by ParaView default one table of statistics over the selected elements per step, otherwise one history per element. Location selections take values from the cell containing each location.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Every time step is computed; keep the selection small and the upstream pipeline lean.
- Turn OnlyReportSelectionStatistics off to get each selected point's own history; the default gives statistics across the selection.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PlotSelectionOverTime`. Identity: `filters/ExtractSelectionOverTime`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input from which the selection is extracted. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkTable","vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `Selection` | Required data input for the native Selection port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input that provides the selection object. Accepted data: selections (vtkSelection). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkSelection"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OnlyReportSelectionStatistics` | If this property is set to 1, the min, max, inter-quartile ranges, and (for numeric arrays) mean and standard deviation of all the selected points or cells within each time step are reported -- instead of breaking each selected point's or cell's attributes out into separate time history tables. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvPlotSelectionOverTime",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input",
    "Selection": "UPSTREAM_Selection"
  }
}
```
